# Phase 1: PLM project structure

Work from the latest `origin/main` (it already has [PLM_SPEC.md](PLM_SPEC.md), which the local snapshot is missing). Create branch `cursor/plm-project-structure-48f7`. This PR is **structure + runnable skeleton only** — not entity/metadata/workflow implementation.

Spec source of truth: [PLM_SPEC.md](PLM_SPEC.md) sections 5–6, 36–40 (Phase 1).

## Scope

In:

- Full monorepo tree from spec §6
- Maven aggregator for Java (Quarkus default; kernel/modules as empty JARs with explicit boundaries)
- pnpm workspace for Next.js + TS packages
- Docker Compose for local appliance (`make dev`)
- Root `Makefile`, `README.md`, `.env.example`, `.gitignore`
- Minimal Quarkus health + Next.js shell
- Flyway placeholder + GitHub Actions CI that compiles

Out:

- Entity kernel, Cerbos policies beyond a stub, Authelia login flow wiring, AI/MCP, domain modules, shadcn screens

```mermaid
flowchart TB
  subgraph apps [apps]
    web[Next.js web]
    api[Quarkus API]
  end
  subgraph kernel [kernel JARs]
    entity[entity]
    metadata[metadata]
    other[other kernel modules]
  end
  subgraph infra [compose]
    pg[PostgreSQL]
    rustfs[RustFS]
    redis[Valkey]
    authelia[Authelia]
    cerbos[Cerbos]
  end
  web -->|REST| api
  api --> kernel
  api --> pg
  api --> rustfs
  api --> redis
  api --> cerbos
  web --> authelia
```

## Layout to create

Match spec §6 at repo root (do not nest under an extra `plm/` folder). Keep existing `LICENSE` and `PLM_SPEC.md`. README will point at `PLM_SPEC.md` rather than duplicating a `SPEC.md`.

- **Apps:** [`apps/api/quarkus`](apps/api/quarkus) (Quarkus REST, Flyway, health/liveness/readiness), [`apps/web/nextjs`](apps/web/nextjs) (App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind, Geist)
- **Kernel:** one Maven module per spec module under [`kernel/`](kernel/) (`entity`, `metadata`, `relationship`, `search`, `semantic`, `ontology`, `graph`, `workflow`, `audit`, `document`, `authorization`, `ai`, `extension`) — each with `src/main/java/io/agentplm/kernel/<name>/package-info.java` and a one-line README
- **Domain modules:** empty Maven modules under [`modules/`](modules/) (`product`, `material`, `supplier`, `season`, `collection`, `sample`, `bom`, `specification`)
- **Extensions:** placeholder dirs + manifests under [`extensions/`](extensions/) (`apparel`, `footwear`, `cpg`, `sustainability`)
- **SDKs:** [`sdk/java`](sdk/java) (Maven), [`sdk/typescript`](sdk/typescript) (package.json stub)
- **Packages:** [`packages/core-schema`](packages/core-schema), [`packages/semantic-model`](packages/semantic-model), [`packages/ui-extension-sdk`](packages/ui-extension-sdk)
- **Schemas / policies / infra / migrations:** [`schemas/core`](schemas/core), [`schemas/extensions`](schemas/extensions), [`policies/cerbos`](policies/cerbos), [`infra/{postgres,rustfs,authelia,cerbos,redis,nginx}`](infra/), [`migrations/`](migrations/)

## Java / Maven

- Root [`pom.xml`](pom.xml): `groupId` `io.agentplm`, Java 25, Quarkus BOM, aggregator listing kernel + modules + `sdk/java` + `apps/api/quarkus`
- Quarkus app depends on kernel modules (empty JARs) so module boundaries are real from day one
- `quarkus-rest`, `quarkus-hibernate-orm-panache` (unused until Phase 2), `quarkus-jdbc-postgresql`, `quarkus-flyway`, `quarkus-hibernate-validator`, `quarkus-opentelemetry`, `quarkus-smallrye-health`, `quarkus-config-yaml`
- Flyway location: repo-root [`migrations/`](migrations/) copied into the API image; first script `V1__extensions.sql` enables `vector` / `pg_trgm` only (no entity tables yet)
- Package convention: `io.agentplm.kernel.*`, `io.agentplm.modules.*`, `io.agentplm.api`

## Frontend / pnpm

- [`pnpm-workspace.yaml`](pnpm-workspace.yaml) for `apps/web/nextjs`, `sdk/typescript`, `packages/*`
- Minimal Next.js app: health/status page, Tailwind, Geist, env `NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL`
- No shadcn install sweep yet (Phase 10); add Tailwind so later UI work has a base

## Docker Compose + Makefile

Files: [`docker-compose.yml`](docker-compose.yml) (shared services), [`docker-compose.dev.yml`](docker-compose.dev.yml) (dev overrides, bind mounts where useful), [`docker-compose.prod.yml`](docker-compose.prod.yml) (nginx + no bind mounts).

`make dev` → `docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up --build`

Services from spec §36:

| Service | Image approach |
|---|---|
| postgres | `pgvector/pgvector` on newest available Postgres (prefer 17/18 if 19 images are not published yet); init from `infra/postgres` |
| rustfs | official RustFS S3-compatible image + named volume |
| redis | Valkey |
| authelia | config stub in `infra/authelia` (login wiring later) |
| cerbos | `infra/cerbos` + empty `policies/cerbos` allow-all stub for health |
| api | Dockerfile in `apps/api/quarkus` |
| web | Dockerfile in `apps/web/nextjs` |
| nginx | prod compose only |

[`.env.example`](.env.example): DB, S3, Redis, OIDC, Cerbos, API/web URLs. No secrets committed.

## Makefile / CI / docs

- Targets: `dev`, `down`, `api`, `web`, `test`, `migrate` (stubs where not yet implemented)
- [`.github/workflows/ci.yml`](.github/workflows/ci.yml): Maven `verify`, pnpm `lint`/`build`, `docker compose config`
- [`README.md`](README.md): product one-liner, how to run `make dev`, stack table, pointer to `PLM_SPEC.md`, current phase

## Verification (after implementation)

- `./mvnw -q verify` succeeds
- `pnpm --filter web build` (or equivalent) succeeds
- `docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml config` is valid
- API `/q/health` and web homepage respond when compose is up (or document if a service image is unavailable in this environment)

## Later phases (not this PR)

Phase 2+ from spec §40: entity kernel, metadata, relationships, core PLM, search, semantic, workflow, AI/MCP, UI, extensions.

    ("graph", "Instance-level knowledge graph traversal over relationships."),

    ("audit", "Immutable audit records for mutations and governance events."),

    ("authorization", "Authorization integration (Cerbos) for protected operations."),
    ("ai", "AI provider abstraction, tools, and MCP capability surface."),

MODULES = [

    ("material", "Materials used in product development and BOM."),
    ("supplier", "Suppliers, vendors, and factories."),
    ("season", "Seasons and calendar concepts."),

    ("sample", "Samples and development requests."),
    ("bom", "Bills of materials and BOM lines."),
    ("specification", "Product and material specifications and measurements."),
]

def write(path: Path, content: str):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(content.lstrip("\n") if content.startswith("\n") else content)
    if not content.endswith("\n"):
        path.write_text(path.read_text() + "\n")

def maven_module_pom(parent_artifact, artifact, name, relative_parent, description):
    return f'''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 https://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
  <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

  <parent>
    <groupId>io.agentplm</groupId>
    <artifactId>{parent_artifact}</artifactId>
    <version>0.1.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
    <relativePath>{relative_parent}</relativePath>
  </parent>

  <artifactId>{artifact}</artifactId>
  <name>{name}</name>
  <description>{description}</description>
</project>
'''

def package_info(package, summary):
    return f'''/**
 * {summary}
 */
package {package};
'''

def readme(title, body):
    return f"# {title}\n\n{body}\n"

# --- kernel aggregator ---
kernel_modules_xml = "\n".join(f"    <module>{n}</module>" for n, _ in KERNEL)
write(ROOT / "kernel/pom.xml", f'''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 https://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
  <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

  <parent>
    <groupId>io.agentplm</groupId>
    <artifactId>agent-plm</artifactId>
    <version>0.1.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
    <relativePath>../pom.xml</relativePath>
  </parent>

  <artifactId>plm-kernel</artifactId>
  <packaging>pom</packaging>
  <name>PLM Kernel</name>
  <description>Logical kernel modules for the AI-native PLM platform.</description>

  <modules>
{kernel_modules_xml}
  </modules>
</project>
''')

write(ROOT / "kernel/README.md", readme("PLM Kernel",
    "Logical modules of the PLM kernel. These are Maven JARs inside a modular monolith, not separate services."))

for name, desc in KERNEL:
    write(ROOT / f"kernel/{name}/pom.xml", maven_module_pom(
        "plm-kernel", f"plm-kernel-{name}", f"PLM Kernel — {name}", "../pom.xml", desc))
    write(ROOT / f"kernel/{name}/README.md", readme(f"kernel/{name}", desc))
    pkg = name.replace("-", "")
    write(ROOT / f"kernel/{name}/src/main/java/io/agentplm/kernel/{pkg}/package-info.java",
          package_info(f"io.agentplm.kernel.{pkg}", desc))
    write(ROOT / f"kernel/{name}/src/test/java/.gitkeep", "")

# --- domain aggregator ---
module_xml = "\n".join(f"    <module>{n}</module>" for n, _ in MODULES)
write(ROOT / "modules/pom.xml", f'''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 https://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">
  <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

  <parent>
    <groupId>io.agentplm</groupId>
    <artifactId>agent-plm</artifactId>
    <version>0.1.0-SNAPSHOT</version>
    <relativePath>../pom.xml</relativePath>
  </parent>

  <artifactId>plm-modules</artifactId>
  <packaging>pom</packaging>
  <name>PLM Domain Modules</name>
  <description>Opinionated core PLM domain modules built on the kernel.</description>

  <modules>
{module_xml}
  </modules>
</project>
''')

write(ROOT / "modules/README.md", readme("PLM Domain Modules",
    "Core PLM domain concepts. All modules use the same Entity/Metadata/Relationship kernel."))

for name, desc in MODULES:
    write(ROOT / f"modules/{name}/pom.xml", maven_module_pom(
        "plm-modules", f"plm-module-{name}", f"PLM Module — {name}", "../pom.xml", desc))
    write(ROOT / f"modules/{name}/README.md", readme(f"modules/{name}", desc))
    write(ROOT / f"modules/{name}/src/main/java/io/agentplm/modules/{name}/package-info.java",
          package_info(f"io.agentplm.modules.{name}", desc))
    write(ROOT / f"modules/{name}/src/test/java/.gitkeep", "")

Yes — there’s a lot of room to speed it up. The current Dockerfile already does dependency-layer caching, but most of the cost is elsewhere.

## What’s slow today

1. **Huge build context** — Compose builds from the repo root (`.`), but [`.dockerignore`](.dockerignore) only excludes `node_modules`, `target`, etc. It still sends `kernel/`, `modules/`, `apps/api/`, `infra/`, `migrations/`, and more on every build.
2. **Full workspace install** — `pnpm install` pulls all 6 workspace packages, even though the web app only needs a subset.
3. **Next.js build does extra work** — `next build` runs ESLint and type-checking inside the image (you already lint in CI).
4. **No BuildKit cache mounts** — when a layer invalidates, `pnpm install` and `.next/cache` start from scratch.
5. **`make dev` rebuilds the image** — for local dev, a bind-mounted `pnpm dev` is usually much faster than rebuilding Docker layers.

## Highest-impact fixes

| Change | Expected gain |
|--------|----------------|
| Expand `.dockerignore` for web builds (`kernel/`, `modules/`, `apps/api/`, `infra/`, `migrations/`, …) | Faster context upload + fewer cache busts |
| BuildKit cache mounts for pnpm store + `.next/cache` | Much faster rebuilds after source changes |
| `pnpm install --filter @agent-plm/web...` | Smaller install |
| `eslint.ignoreDuringBuilds: true` in Docker (keep lint in CI) | Shorter `next build` |
| Dev compose override: mount source + `pnpm dev`, skip image build | Fastest local iteration |

## Example optimized pattern

```dockerfile

FROM node:22-alpine AS deps
WORKDIR /repo
RUN corepack enable
COPY package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml pnpm-lock.yaml .npmrc ./
COPY apps/web/nextjs/package.json apps/web/nextjs/
COPY sdk/typescript/package.json sdk/typescript/
COPY packages/*/package.json packages/
RUN --mount=type=cache,id=pnpm-store,target=/pnpm/store \
    pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --filter @agent-plm/web...

FROM deps AS build
COPY apps/web/nextjs apps/web/nextjs
COPY sdk/typescript sdk/typescript
COPY packages packages
ENV NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1
RUN --mount=type=cache,id=next-cache,target=/repo/apps/web/nextjs/.next/cache \
    pnpm --filter @agent-plm/web build
```

And a tighter `.dockerignore` for the web image:

```gitignore

apps/api/
infra/
migrations/
extensions/

pom.xml

```

- **CI / production image:** cache mounts + tighter `.dockerignore` + filtered `pnpm install`
- **Local dev:** don’t rebuild the web image on every `make dev`; run Next.js on the host or via a dev Compose service with volume mounts

EXPOSE 3000
ENTRYPOINT ["docker-dev-entrypoint.sh"]
